label: Task-21
title: Add Cytoscape.js graph visualization option
description:
Add Cytoscape.js as an alternative graph visualization library.

## Why Cytoscape.js?
- Industry standard for biological/network analysis
- Powerful graph algorithms built-in (shortest path, clustering, centrality)
- Extensive extension ecosystem
- Excellent for analysis use cases
- Supports compound nodes (nested groups)

## Implementation
1. Add cytoscape CDN to index.html
2. Create `graph-viewer-cytoscape.js` component
3. Map API response to Cytoscape format:
   ```javascript
   const elements = [
     { data: { id: 'Feature-12', label: 'Feature-12', type: 'feature' } },
     { data: { id: 'Task-14', label: 'Task-14', type: 'task' } },
     { data: { source: 'Feature-12', target: 'Task-14', label: 'has-task' } }
   ];
   ```
4. Add layout options: cola, dagre, breadthfirst, circle
5. Expose graph algorithms for analysis

## Pros
- Powerful analysis capabilities
- Compound nodes for grouping
- Many layout algorithms
- Export to various formats

## Cons
- Steeper learning curve
- More complex API
